answer.reason: The one deed told of Kish himself is that he sent Saul to seek his lost asses; the other verses only list him as Saul's father or name Saul.

clauses.english: sent his son Saul to seek his lost asses
clauses.quote: Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.

doubts: 1SA 10:11, 10:21, 1CH 12:1, 1CH 26:28 and ACT 13:21 mention Kish only as Saul's father, so they were not used.
The summary already gives his burial in Zelah (2SA 21:14), so it is not repeated.
